name: installment-pos
description: Installment POS & Inventory Management System - License activation required

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "vite --host" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:5174 --timeout 30000 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron . || cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5174 electron ."
scripts.build:web:full: cross-env VITE_NO_DEMO=true VITE_IS_BETA=true VITE_BUILD_EDITION=full vite build
scripts.build:web:trial: cross-env VITE_NO_DEMO=true VITE_IS_BETA=true VITE_BUILD_EDITION=trial vite build
scripts.build:electron:full: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true VITE_NO_DEMO=true VITE_IS_BETA=true VITE_BUILD_EDITION=full vite build
scripts.build:electron:trial: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true VITE_NO_DEMO=true VITE_IS_BETA=true VITE_BUILD_EDITION=trial vite build
scripts.electron:build:full: npm run build:electron:full && cross-env BUILD_SUFFIX=-full electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:trial: npm run build:electron:trial && cross-env BUILD_SUFFIX=-trial electron-builder
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web:full && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build: npm run build:web:full && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:build:full: cross-env CAP_BUILD=true npm run build:web:full && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk','release/Facility-POS-'+require('./package.json').version+'-full.apk')"
scripts.cap:build:trial: cross-env CAP_BUILD=true npm run build:web:trial && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk','release/Facility-POS-'+require('./package.json').version+'-trial.apk')"
